_comment: Rounding scale in CSS pixels at 1x. Every generator and config snippet reads from here.

frame_border.size: Large (6 px as Darkly draws it)
frame_border.note: real decoration border; KWin BorderSize=Large, BorderSizeAuto=false, Darkly BorderSize=BorderLarge. Band colour #333333; header colour set to the window colour (36,36,36) so titlebar and content are one inset panel

frame_inner_band.note: effect second outline painted over the border from the inside; its rounded inner edge gives the content a 6 px corner radius (window 12 minus band 6)

frame_edge_line.note: effect edge outline at the frame radius, so it follows the corner exactly
